details:
1. Open VrChat

2. Join any instance

3. One of these will happen (50% either):

A) I join that instance

B) I join a new random instance or it creates a new friends only instance

Video with the bug

https://mega.nz/file/ScoEBKDK#Bb_KfNdCrGCnB-SErSwK20ADKel3jKy8nRf3nl3Pt1w

This happens on both PC 2D and PCVR

This happens on any account logged from my computer

I have 2 network connections, and both have the same problem

It causes a lot of problems because it triggers in every scenario

Ex. I enter a friends' portal, I get spawned in a completely different instance

Ex. A friend invites me in a private lobby with only me and him, I get spawned in a completely different instance

Looking a the log, I see this error multiple times

 [Behaviour] Lost connection to realtime network while entering world: ConnectingToMasterServer

2024.05.06 11:29:56 Log        -  [Behaviour] Entering world

2024.05.06 11:29:56 Log        -  [Behaviour] Entering Room: The Black Cat

2024.05.06 11:29:56 Error      -  [Behaviour] Cannot join room. Connection not ready for join operations

2024.05.06 11:29:56 Error      -  [Behaviour] Lost connection to realtime network while entering world: ConnectingToMasterServer

2024.05.06 11:29:56 Log        -  [Behaviour] World download took 58.0ms

2024.05.06 11:29:56 Log        -  [Behaviour] Spent 0.0ms waiting for GO

2024.05.06 11:29:56 Log        -  [Behaviour] World loading took 5,182.0ms

...

2024.05.06 11:29:56 Log        -  [Behaviour] Resetting game flow because "Lost connection to realtime network while entering world": [TryAlternateInstance, SkipLogin]

The bug started since about 1-2 months ago

I've been playing for 2 years and it was always fine
title: Joining a existing instance almost always takes me somewhere completely different
